Find the perfect order of a distinct set of symbols to operate the system at its best!

Depending on the order is the system's performance.
Each symbol can only be present once in the output sequence.

Here are the four symbols with their performance properties:
A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol
B = yields best performance if not preceded by symbols A and/or B
C = yields best performance unless it is the last symbol
D = yields best performance when being the first symbol

To find the perfect order of the distinct set of symbols, we need to consider their performance properties. Since D yields the best performance when being the first symbol, let's start with D. Next, since A yields the best performance if not followed by more than one symbol, we should place A after D. Now, since B yields the best performance if not preceded by symbols A and/or B, we can place B after A. Finally, since C yields the best performance unless it is the last symbol, we should place C after B. Therefore, the perfect order of the distinct set of symbols to operate the system at its best is D-A-B-C.
